clauses.original_clause: Reusable genuine native SwiftUI/Compose production component.
Both sealIntact and coolantReady are required for release.
Broken seal has priority over missing coolant.
Missing coolant is independently exercised by P2 replacement.
Acknowledgement starts unchecked.
Forward acknowledgement selection sets true and emits onAcknowledgementChange(true) exactly once.
Selecting acknowledgement again before release clears it and emits false.
Acknowledgement cannot override seal/coolant holds.
Eligible acknowledged unrequested primary calls onRelease(current ID) exactly once.
Successful release records requested state.
No second release is possible in requested local state.
Component only records a request and performs no physical transfer.
Disclosure starts closed.
Disclosure toggles open and closed, showing or hiding all note headings and bodies.
Disclosure preserves caller pair order.
Disclosure emits no caller callback.
Review handling / Hide handling labels track disclosure.
Different model ID resets acknowledgement to false.
Different model ID resets disclosure to closed.
Different model ID resets requested to false.
New title, destination, temperature and guards render in same mounted component.
Caller update emits zero business callbacks.
Exact five-way status precedence and exact visible/accessibility strings.
Primary enabled iff sealIntact && coolantReady && acknowledged && !requested.
Subtitle is destination + middle-dot separator + temperatureRange.
Exact normal/requested primary labels and unchecked/checked confirmation labels.
Original overview/permitted/requested/replaced checkpoints remain full with original action meaning.
Ordinary 400x600 and narrow 280x600 with iOS xxxLarge / Android 1.3 scale.
Public light/LTR parent padding 16 horizontal and 24 top, offered component width requested minus 32.
Same source and production APIs in every case.
Full-width pale canvas with white surface.
Ink accent, title, subtitle, status, disclosure, expanded material, choice and primary occur in one vertical flow.
Actual choice-to-primary control-edge gap is 12 +/-0.75 native units in one frame.
Status text starts at least 16 native units inside actual painted band.
Whole leading 4 percent of status is empty of text/other paint and contains only status fill.
All text visibly wraps completely.
Text uses no line limits.
Status grows to accommodate wrapped status text.
Do not manufacture scrolling with fixed-height blank spacer rows.
Parent owns scrolling; component has no nested scroller.
Fixed opaque sRGB canvas/surface/ink/status/primary roles have separate rendered evidence.
Title hierarchy, wrapping, overlap and clipping have separate source-backed visual propositions.
Native semantic labels, selected and enabled facts establish state.
Two independent judges inspect original evidence for qualitative atoms.
Static reference rasterization is not a cross-platform native pixel baseline.
Long expanded content requires overlapping sweeps and actual bottom reachability.
Disabled attempts do not count as callback dispatch.
Choice/primary callbacks require successful native activation; update requires actual same-process update method and original interval.
Prove mounted production component under declared observer parent; exclude unrelated app/hardware/lifecycle scope.
